class.name: NNSTNodes
class.brief_description: Base class for all State Tree nodes.
class.description: Shared base node for Noodle Nodes State Trees, which combine hierarchical state machines with optional utility-based state selection. Build a state tree by adding an [NNSTRoot] and nesting [NNSTNode] and [NNSTParallel] states beneath it. Add [NNSTTransition] children to define event-driven or automatic transitions (optionally gated by [NNSTGuard] resources), and [NNSTHistory] children on compound states to remember and restore their last active substate. Each tick runs [method NNSTTickedNodes.on_tick] top-down along the active state chain, letting parent states hold shared logic while leaf states handle specific behaviour.
